caption: The drawing features a three-dimensional illustration of a wooden cradle or bassinet, colored in shades of brown with a lighter brown inner base and slightly darker brown for the sides and ends. The cradle has curved sides and a rectangular base, with two oval-shaped handholds cut into the shorter sides near the top edge. The edges are outlined in a grayish-white color, highlighting the structure’s contours. Below the illustration, there are two technical line drawings showing a side elevation and an end elevation of the cradle. The side view is labeled “SIDE ELEVATION” and includes measurements: 37 inches in length, 13 inches in height at the tallest point, 32 inches for the base, and 23 3/4 inches for the lower part of the base. The handhold is 3 by 1 inch. The end view is labeled “END ELEVATION” and includes a overall width of 22 1/2 inches at the base, 4 1/2 inches for the central section, and a total height of 13 inches. The background of the drawing is a plain, light beige color.
title: Cradle
